performance.summary: Chromium SwiftShader review: 17.1 average sampled FPS at 1440×900 with software-only adaptive scale 0.58; diagnostics also executed at 1920×1080 and 390×844. Hardware GPU performance was not available in this environment.

limitations: Administrator policy blocked local URL navigation in the review browser, so Chromium executed the exact packaged HTML, CSS, and JavaScript through page.set_content; the normal index.html route was not independently navigated.
Performance was measured only on SwiftShader software rendering. The hardware GPU path remains unmeasured.
Procedural audio requires a user gesture before playback.
